gen-dafont-neon-gf-ubuntu-sans: Neon glows with tall, stamped-metal lowercase and a line that never changes width. Ubuntu Sans has big, washer-round eyes in its lowercase, so paragraphs of it feel open and friendly to move through.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-vend-sans: Pure glow-sign energy: Neon draws tall lowercase at a constant line width, with generous space between every glyph pair. Vend Sans holds a ruler-straight rhythm, its tall x-height filling every line comfortably.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-orbit: Sealed and digital, Neuropol is at its best turning letters into slim single-weight outlines. But Orbit, a sans-serif, does its best work the other way, curves stopping short and characters floating apart.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-science-gothic: Futuristic and digital, Neuropol closes its letters into slim single-weight outlines. Science Gothic, the sans-serif, loosens things with wide-set stroke ends, so the eye moves from sealed shapes to open ones.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-syncopate: Neuropol shuts its letters into slim, single-weight outlines with a digital, futuristic look. And Syncopate keeps open letters on a technical-pen footing, spaced like rungs on a rope ladder, so longer text moves steadily.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-abeezee: Neuropolitical pulls its words apart, letter by letter, in glowing neon-tube lines. ABeeZee, with a high mean line and terminals finishing well away from the stem, gives that glow a friendlier partner.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-aldrich: Neuropolitical is at its best stretching words out letter by letter, each one a glowing neon tube. Aldrich, a sans, does its best work with a tall x-height, cupped round letters, and a single thick thread.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-athiti: Contemporary and geometric, Neuropolitical stretches words apart like glowing neon tubes of one line thickness. And Athiti, a sans-serif, adds a high mean line and a see-through gap in each s.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-atkinson-hy: Neon-tube letters pulled apart one by one define Neuropolitical, glowing at a single line thickness. But Atkinson Hyperlegible does its best with wide-set terminals on the s and clipped capitals beside its lowercase.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like stretched stencil bridges, with clipped capitals and ascenders set against the lowercase. Neuropolitical, in pencil-light glow, feels loose and playful beside it.
